description:
The ideal candidate should know the ins and outs of the language and is a master at using server side technology and programming to find creative solutions to functionality requirements. 
  
 The candidate must have a strong competency in PHP/MySQL , and have a passion for staying up to date with the latest trends and best practices.
  
 Requirements / Experience:
 ∙             3+ years’ experience building web applications with PHP 
 ∙             Experience storing/retrieving data using MySQL or similar DB 
 ∙             Experience with RESTful web services (JSON APIs, etc)
 ∙             Good Front End skills in HTML/CSS/Javascript 
 ∙             Understanding of object-oriented programming, concepts of abstraction, etc
 ∙             Experience in custom CMS s and e-commerce
  
 What You Will Do:
 ∙             Collaborate with Front End Developers to complete development projects successfully and on  time
 ∙             Develop back end for web based solutions using PHP/MySQL 
 ∙             Participate in all aspects of development (planning, architecture, development and deployment)
 ∙             Refactor and optimize code Skills:
 ∙             PHP, MySQL, MVC/OOP, Javascript, HTML/HTML5, CSS/CSS3 (SASS is a plus), Git/GitHub, LAMP/Linux, command line (shell/bash)
